prompt_en: Create one photorealistic 35 mm deep-focus environmental photograph from a low ridge after clearing monsoon rain. The principal subject is a broad karst plateau whose surface water visibly drains underground and returns as a spring. Arrange karst closed-depression drainage endpoints in one continuous exterior vista: exposed pale jointed solution-weathered rock anchors the drainage landform; a bowl or sink-shaped closed depression lacks an ordinary surface outlet; a surface stream visibly narrows and enters a sink opening or swallow hole; and a distinct spring or cave-mouth outlet releases water elsewhere in the same landscape as a visible flowing pool. The drainage chain remains the principal environmental subject across the entire frame. The photographed water path visibly changes from surface flow to disappearance and distant release. One continuous lower-ridge vista contains the basin, swallow point, cave mouth, and spring pool. Wet charcoal slabs carry sharp rills, scalloped pits, and moss-filled joints. Foreground markers, midground sink basin, and lower-slope outlet create a readable depth sequence. Rain-polished stone and turquoise runoff create a storm-cleared field-study palette. Place one unmistakably adult documentary landscape photographer with the reference portrait's general facial appearance, long dark softly waved hair, and natural facial texture in the lower-left quarter, occupying roughly one fifth of the frame, placing two small red flow markers beside the exact point where a rain-fed stream sinks into a limestone opening. Keep her face and three-quarter pose readable while the basin, swallow point, and separate blue-green resurgence remain unobstructed. Let the visible surface endpoints stand on their own, with the unseen underground route remaining contextual rather than claimed as pixel proof. Use clearing mist, foreground runoff, oblique late-afternoon sunlight, realistic anatomy and scale, natural skin texture, crisp geological depth, and coherent wet-rock reflections.
negative_en: excessive HDR, over-processed retouching, cartoon style, 3D render look, illustration look, fake-looking background, low resolution
